Fixed some simple bugs

New Difficulties

Story Mode
Normal Mode
Nightmare Mode


New Challenges

Randomized Items
Hell


Hell Explained

When in “Hell Mode,” if the player isn’t in a cut-scene, then every second their maximum health is degraded by 0.013 out of the starting maximum health of 100. 
All rings that typically change the player’s maximum health are removed.
If the player’s maximum health ever reaches 0, then it is GAME OVER.
The only way to stop this maximum health degradation is by acquiring, and equipping the “Timeless Ring.”
With the “Timeless Ring” equipped, the player must then finish the rest of the game with the remainder of their health left.
The player has around 2 hours to equip the “Timeless Ring.”
